notes: Each feature task is atomic for a single Vibe Coding session (~50-100 LOC).
Titles prefixed with [P] are parallelizable once their dependencies are satisfied.
Every feature task contains a required Verification sub-task.

tasks.title: Initialize Turborepo and npm workspaces
tasks.description: Create root workspace configuration and baseline package manifests for apps and packages.
acceptance_criteria: Root workspace recognizes `apps/*` and `packages/*`.
Running workspace install succeeds without unresolved local package references.
Base folder structure exists for `apps/web` and `packages/*` targets.

verification_subtask.title: Verification: Validate workspace bootstrap
verification_subtask.description: Run install and workspace listing commands to confirm monorepo discovery.
acceptance_criteria: Workspace install completes successfully.
Workspace command lists all intended packages.
No missing-workspace warnings are shown.

tasks.title: Configure `turbo.json` task pipeline
tasks.description: Define build, lint, test, and typecheck pipelines with task outputs and cache boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: Turbo pipeline includes build, lint, typecheck, and test tasks.
Task dependencies align with package graph.
Local run executes tasks in expected order.

verification_subtask.title: Verification: Run Turbo dry pipeline
verification_subtask.description: Execute turbo task graph command and verify dependency ordering.
acceptance_criteria: Turbo graph resolves without cycle errors.
Root and package tasks are discovered.
Cache/output settings are applied to configured tasks.

tasks.title: [P] Configure root `tsconfig.json` for monorepo paths
tasks.description: Add strict compiler options and shared path aliases for all workspace packages.
acceptance_criteria: Root TypeScript config enables strict mode.
Path aliases resolve `@vibe/*` package imports.
Child package tsconfig files can extend the root config.

verification_subtask.title: Verification: Run TypeScript project references check
verification_subtask.description: Execute a root typecheck and confirm alias resolution across packages.
acceptance_criteria: TypeScript resolves workspace path aliases.
No config inheritance errors appear.
Typecheck exits successfully for configured projects.

tasks.title: [P] Create `@vibe/ui` with shared Tailwind preset
tasks.description: Set up `@vibe/ui` package, shared design tokens, and reusable Tailwind preset consumed by app packages.
acceptance_criteria: `@vibe/ui` package exports UI primitives and style entrypoints.
Shared Tailwind configuration is reusable from `apps/web`.
A sample styled component renders with shared tokens.

verification_subtask.title: Verification: Build `@vibe/ui` package
verification_subtask.description: Run package build/typecheck and confirm shared styles compile.
acceptance_criteria: Package build succeeds.
Tailwind preset is importable from `apps/web`.
No unresolved style/token imports remain.

tasks.title: Integrate Shadcn/ui into `apps/web` via `@vibe/ui`
tasks.description: Configure Shadcn/ui component generation and route all shared components through `@vibe/ui` exports.
acceptance_criteria: Shadcn/ui components are generated and wrapped in `@vibe/ui`.
`apps/web` imports shared UI from `@vibe/ui` rather than local duplicates.
Theme tokens and utility classes are consistent across app screens.

verification_subtask.title: Verification: Render Shadcn component in app
verification_subtask.description: Run web app locally and confirm shared Shadcn component styling.
acceptance_criteria: Web app starts without component import errors.
Rendered shared component matches Tailwind token usage.
No duplicate local UI component paths remain in app imports.

tasks.title: Implement `@vibe/schema` core Zod contracts from PRD
tasks.description: Define `BriefSchema`, `PRDSchema`, `TaskTreeSchema`, `DesignMapSchema`, and shared enums aligned to PRD/acceptance criteria.
acceptance_criteria: All required schema roots are implemented in `@vibe/schema`.
Enums match documented status/category values from spec.
Schemas parse representative valid fixtures and reject invalid fixtures.

verification_subtask.title: Verification: Run schema unit tests
verification_subtask.description: Execute schema test suite (Vitest or equivalent) for parse success/failure fixtures.
acceptance_criteria: Schema tests pass for valid fixtures.
Negative fixtures fail with expected messages.
Coverage includes all top-level schema exports.

tasks.title: Publish schema package entrypoints and validation helpers
tasks.description: Export inferred TS types and helper validators so all generators validate outputs before persistence.
acceptance_criteria: `@vibe/schema` exports both Zod schemas and inferred TS types.
Validation helpers return structured error objects for UI/AI flows.
Downstream packages can import helpers without circular dependencies.

verification_subtask.title: Verification: Typecheck consumer imports
verification_subtask.description: Typecheck a sample consumer in another package using exported schema helpers.
acceptance_criteria: Consumer import path resolves without local hacks.
Inferred types are usable in consumer package code.
Build output exposes expected public API surface.

tasks.title: [P] Implement `@vibe/database` Supabase client and env guards
tasks.description: Create typed Supabase server/client initialization with runtime environment validation.
acceptance_criteria: Supabase URL/key env vars are validated at startup.
Reusable typed client factory exists for server-side usage.
Connection helper can be imported by repositories and API routes.

verification_subtask.title: Verification: Check Supabase client initialization
verification_subtask.description: Run a lightweight connectivity check against configured Supabase project.
acceptance_criteria: Env validation fails fast on missing variables.
Valid env configuration creates a client successfully.
Connectivity check returns expected status response.

tasks.title: Create initial SQL migrations for core pipeline tables
tasks.description: Add migration scripts for `projects`, `project_sessions`, `clarifications`, `artifacts`, `tasks`, `design_nodes`, and `design_task_links`.
acceptance_criteria: Migration scripts create all required tables and constraints.
Enum/check constraints reflect spec-defined status values.
Migration can be applied cleanly to an empty database.

verification_subtask.title: Verification: Apply and inspect migration
verification_subtask.description: Run migration and verify table presence plus critical constraints.
acceptance_criteria: All expected tables are present after migration.
Primary/foreign keys and unique constraints are created.
Rollback/reapply works without drift errors.

tasks.title: [P] Generate DB types and add typed repository modules
tasks.description: Generate TypeScript database types and implement repositories for core entities with strict DTO mapping.
acceptance_criteria: Generated DB types are available in `@vibe/database`.
Repositories exist for projects, sessions, clarifications, artifacts, and tasks.
Repository methods return typed domain objects aligned with schema contracts.

verification_subtask.title: Verification: Run repository integration checks
verification_subtask.description: Execute targeted repository tests against a migrated database.
acceptance_criteria: CRUD operations succeed for each core repository.
Returned types satisfy TypeScript checks without casts.
Repository writes preserve schema-required fields.

tasks.title: Scaffold `@vibe/ai` LangGraph state machine core
tasks.description: Create graph state model, node contracts, and reducer wiring for staged pipeline execution.
acceptance_criteria: Graph state shape includes stage, status, node, and error metadata.
Node contract interface is shared for all pipeline nodes.
State reducer supports deterministic stage transitions.

verification_subtask.title: Verification: Execute graph bootstrap test
verification_subtask.description: Run a minimal graph invocation and assert initial state transitions.
acceptance_criteria: Graph initializes with expected default state.
Reducer transitions through at least one node.
Typecheck passes for node contract implementations.

tasks.title: Implement persisted checkpoints to `project_sessions.state_json`
tasks.description: Persist and reload graph checkpoints to support interruption, resume, and failure recovery.
acceptance_criteria: Graph writes checkpoint payloads to `project_sessions.state_json`.
Resume path restores state from latest checkpoint.
Failure metadata is persisted in `last_error` when node retries are exhausted.

verification_subtask.title: Verification: Simulate interrupt and resume
verification_subtask.description: Run graph with an intentional pause and confirm successful continuation.
acceptance_criteria: Interrupted run updates `graph_status` appropriately.
Resume operation continues from stored checkpoint.
State snapshots remain valid JSON across writes.

tasks.title: [P] Implement `IntakeNormalizer` node
tasks.description: Build node logic that converts raw intake input into `BriefSchema` and stores versioned brief artifact.
acceptance_criteria: Node output validates against `BriefSchema`.
Validation errors return structured feedback payload.
Successful output persists a new brief artifact version.

verification_subtask.title: Verification: Run IntakeNormalizer node test
verification_subtask.description: Execute node test with valid and invalid intake fixtures.
acceptance_criteria: Valid fixture produces persisted brief artifact.
Invalid fixture returns schema error details.
Node retry path follows configured policy.

tasks.title: [P] Implement `GapDetector` node
tasks.description: Build node logic that identifies unresolved requirement gaps and emits ranked clarification candidates.
acceptance_criteria: Gap categories include roles, NFR, edge cases, integrations, and security.
Node output includes priority and source for each gap.
Critical gaps route flow toward clarification generation path.

verification_subtask.title: Verification: Run GapDetector node test
verification_subtask.description: Execute node test to confirm gap ranking and stage routing behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Returned gaps are categorized and prioritized.
No-gap scenario advances to PRD stage path.
Critical-gap scenario triggers clarification branch.

tasks.title: Wire Intake + GapDetector transitions, retries, and interrupt/resume
tasks.description: Connect node sequence with retry policy and user-input interruption semantics in the graph executor.
acceptance_criteria: Graph transitions from Intake to GapDetector on valid brief output.
Retry policy enforces max two retries before failure state.
Interrupted-for-input status can be resumed to continue pipeline.

verification_subtask.title: Verification: Execute orchestration flow test
verification_subtask.description: Run integration test covering success, retry, and interrupted branches.
acceptance_criteria: Success branch reaches expected downstream stage.
Failure branch persists `last_error` after retry cap.
Interrupted branch can resume with same session id.

tasks.title: Create `apps/web` FSD skeleton for app/processes/widgets/features/entities/shared
tasks.description: Set up folder boundaries and baseline contracts to enforce Feature-Sliced Design import direction.
acceptance_criteria: All six FSD layers exist in `apps/web/src`.
Import boundaries are documented and enforceable by lint/config.
Route shell references layers according to FSD direction.

verification_subtask.title: Verification: Validate FSD boundary rules
verification_subtask.description: Run lint/static checks to confirm disallowed cross-layer imports are blocked.
acceptance_criteria: Boundary checks pass for valid imports.
Intentional invalid import is flagged by tooling.
App builds with layer-compliant wiring.

tasks.title: Build Project Intake form in `features` layer
tasks.description: Implement intake form UI, validation, and submit action under `apps/web/src/features` with no widget/process leakage.
acceptance_criteria: Feature form captures required intake fields.
Validation feedback is shown inline for invalid entries.
Submission persists project + brief kickoff data through approved APIs.

verification_subtask.title: Verification: Run intake feature tests
verification_subtask.description: Execute component/action tests for form validation and submit flow.
acceptance_criteria: Required field validation test passes.
Successful submit triggers expected persistence call.
Error path test shows actionable feedback state.

tasks.title: Build Clarification UI in `widgets` layer with feature actions
tasks.description: Compose clarification list widget in `widgets` and keep question/answer mutations in `features` layer.
acceptance_criteria: Clarification widget renders question, category, and priority data.
Answer and status updates are handled by feature-level actions.
Data persistence uses entities/shared API modules only.

verification_subtask.title: Verification: Run clarifications interaction tests
verification_subtask.description: Test question rendering and answer/status update interactions.
acceptance_criteria: Widget displays prioritized clarification rows.
Answer submission updates persisted status.
Resolved/open toggles reflect backend state.

tasks.title: [P] Implement graph session entity and status polling/subscription client
tasks.description: Create `entities/session` model and shared API client to read LangGraph state updates from persisted sessions.
acceptance_criteria: Session entity model maps `project_sessions` state fields.
Client supports polling or realtime subscription mode.
Status payloads are normalized for widget consumption.

verification_subtask.title: Verification: Validate session status data flow
verification_subtask.description: Run integration test with mocked state updates and UI consumer binding.
acceptance_criteria: Session state updates are received by client.
Normalized status values match UI expectations.
Polling/subscription cleanup avoids duplicate listeners.

tasks.title: Implement real-time stage status widget
tasks.description: Build `widgets/stage-status` that visualizes current stage, graph status, and blockers using session entity data.
acceptance_criteria: Widget displays current stage and graph execution status.
UI updates when session state changes without page refresh.
Interrupted/failed states surface actionable next-step hints.

verification_subtask.title: Verification: Test real-time status widget updates
verification_subtask.description: Run UI test to confirm live update rendering on incoming state changes.
acceptance_criteria: Stage and status labels update on new payloads.
Failed/interrupted states render distinct UI treatment.
No hydration/state mismatch errors occur in app runtime.

tasks.title: Add stage control actions in `processes` layer
tasks.description: Implement start, resume, and approve stage actions in `processes` orchestrating feature/entity modules.
acceptance_criteria: Process actions trigger AI flow start/resume operations.
Approval action guards downstream stage transitions.
Processes consume features/entities without violating FSD boundaries.

verification_subtask.title: Verification: Exercise process-level stage controls
verification_subtask.description: Run integration test covering start, interrupt, resume, and approve actions.
acceptance_criteria: Start action creates or updates a project session.
Resume action continues interrupted session correctly.
Approve action gates next stage as intended.

tasks.title: [P] Build `@vibe/integrations` Figma REST adapter
tasks.description: Implement Figma adapter for file/frame/node metadata pull with retry and rate-limit handling.
acceptance_criteria: Adapter accepts Figma URL/key and retrieves target metadata.
Rate-limit and transient error handling is implemented.
Adapter output can be mapped into design node storage schema.

verification_subtask.title: Verification: Run Figma adapter contract tests
verification_subtask.description: Execute adapter tests with mocked and sample real API responses.
acceptance_criteria: Adapter parses expected node metadata structure.
Retry logic handles transient errors.
Invalid Figma input returns structured adapter errors.

tasks.title: [P] Build `@vibe/integrations` Linear SDK adapter
tasks.description: Implement Linear issue creation adapter for task payload export with robust field mapping.
acceptance_criteria: Adapter maps task payload fields to Linear issue input.
Adapter supports idempotent export behavior or duplicate protection strategy.
Adapter returns created issue identifiers for persistence.

verification_subtask.title: Verification: Run Linear adapter integration checks
verification_subtask.description: Test adapter against mocked SDK client and validate field mapping.
acceptance_criteria: Required Linear fields are populated in request payload.
Created issue IDs are returned in normalized format.
Adapter surfaces SDK failures with actionable error metadata.

tasks.title: Implement `ImplementationPlanner` node for `.cursor/rules` generation
tasks.description: Add AI node that composes implementation artifacts and proposed `.cursor/rules` content from validated upstream specs.
acceptance_criteria: Node consumes validated PRD/task/design inputs only.
Node output includes rule drafts mapped to architecture/task/design constraints.
Generated payload is schema-validated before persistence/export.

verification_subtask.title: Verification: Run ImplementationPlanner node test
verification_subtask.description: Execute node tests for valid and invalid artifact inputs.
acceptance_criteria: Node emits rules draft for valid input bundle.
Invalid input bundle is rejected by schema validation.
Persisted output includes versioned artifact metadata.

tasks.title: Build Export Center UI in `widgets` + `features` layers
tasks.description: Implement export center screen showing export readiness, destination controls, and operation history.
acceptance_criteria: Export Center displays readiness state for required artifacts.
User can trigger repository export and Linear export actions.
Feature-layer actions and widget composition follow FSD boundaries.

verification_subtask.title: Verification: Test Export Center interaction flow
verification_subtask.description: Run UI tests for export readiness display and action triggers.
acceptance_criteria: Readiness indicators reflect missing/approved artifacts.
Export action buttons call expected feature handlers.
Operation status updates render in the history section.

tasks.title: Implement export service for `project-spec/*` artifacts and status logging
tasks.description: Create backend export workflow to emit markdown/json/rules files and persist export operation status.
acceptance_criteria: Export service writes required artifact set to target repository structure.
Export status and timestamps are persisted for audit/history.
Service blocks export when approval gate conditions are unmet.

verification_subtask.title: Verification: Run export service integration test
verification_subtask.description: Execute end-to-end export simulation and inspect generated files and status logs.
acceptance_criteria: Expected files are generated in target location.
Export run writes status record with terminal state.
Approval gate prevents export when prerequisites are incomplete.

tasks.title: Generate internal .cursor/rules for the project itself based on the finalized spec.
tasks.description: Produce the final internal ruleset that enforces architecture, FSD boundaries, task execution discipline, design sync constraints, and output format gates.
acceptance_criteria: Rules reference finalized artifacts in `project-spec/*` as source of truth.
Rules enforce package dependency direction and FSD import boundaries.
Rules include guardrails for schema validation and approval-before-export.

verification_subtask.title: Verification: Validate generated internal rules consistency
verification_subtask.description: Review and lint generated rules against finalized spec artifacts and architecture constraints.
acceptance_criteria: Each rule maps to an explicit finalized spec artifact.
No rule contradicts FSD or package dependency constraints.
Rule set passes lint/format checks and is ready for enforcement.
